            ### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Memory-bounded sampled softmax with exact position-weighted gradient accumulation
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            seq, pos, neg = sample_batch(
                user_train,
                itemnum,
                BATCH_SIZE,
                MAXLEN,
                num_negatives=SAMPLED_NEGATIVES,
            )
            seq_t = torch.as_tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            pos_t = torch.as_tensor(pos, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            neg_t = torch.as_tensor(neg, dtype=torch.long, device=device)

            indices = (seq_t != 0) & (pos_t != 0) & (neg_t != 0).any(dim=-1)
            if not indices.any():
                continue
            features = model(seq_t)[indices]
            candidate_ids = torch.cat(
                (pos_t[indices].unsqueeze(-1), neg_t[indices]), dim=-1
            )
            # Candidate embeddings otherwise occupy N x 33 x D storage plus
            # backward buffers. Release each chunk before scoring the next.
            # The detached leaf collects dL/dh; the shared backbone is then
            # traversed once. Tied item embeddings receive both gradient paths.
            score_features = features.detach().requires_grad_(True)
            position_count = features.shape[0]
            loss = features.new_zeros(())
            for start in range(0, position_count, 1024):
                stop = min(start + 1024, position_count)
                ids = candidate_ids[start:stop]
                logits = torch.einsum(
                    "nd,nkd->nk",
                    score_features[start:stop],
                    model.item_emb(ids),
                )
                logits = logits.masked_fill(ids == 0, -torch.inf)
                chunk_loss = ranking_criterion(
                    logits,
                    torch.zeros(stop - start, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
                ) * ((stop - start) / position_count)
                chunk_loss.backward()
                loss = loss + chunk_loss.detach()
                del logits, chunk_loss
            if score_features.grad is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Sampled softmax produced no feature gradient")
            features.backward(score_features.grad)
